index.description: Camera number: 0 is usually built-in, 1 may be USB.

driver.description: OpenCV for webcam/USB/URL; Picamera2 for Raspberry Pi CSI cameras; sim renders the simulated world (sim/render_scene.py).

source.description: null uses index; otherwise a camera number, device path or stream URL. Never commit passwords.

backend.description: OpenCV capture backend. auto tries DirectShow then default for Windows camera indices.

fps.description: Requested capture FPS; actual rate depends on hardware, resolution and exposure.

startup_timeout_s.description: Stop if no initial image arrives within this many seconds.

maximum_frame_age_s.description: Stop when the last received frame is older than this many seconds. Excludes unknown upstream buffering.

maximum_read_failures.description: Stop after this many consecutive unsuccessful capture reads.

human_model.description: Optional people-focused checkpoint; empty disables the second model.

human_minimum_confidence.description: Minimum confidence for human specialist proposals, mapped to person.

model.description: Prepared weights/model directory relative to project root.

image_size.description: Model input size; smaller is faster, larger may recognize small objects better.

minimum_confidence.description: Minimum label confidence, not distance confidence.

mode.description: size = assumed object height; ground = calibrated ground plane; off = no estimates.

horizontal_fov_degrees.description: Assumed horizontal camera angle if no focal calibration. Default is unverified.

assumed_object_heights_m.description: Class name to assumed full upright object height in metres.

camera_height_m.description: Measured lens height above level ground for ground mode; null = not set.

camera_downward_tilt_degrees.description: Measured tilt below horizontal for ground mode: 0 = level, positive = down.

focal_calibration.description: Helper writes focal_px and image_width here.

maximum_distance_m.description: Reporting limit in metres; not an accuracy claim.

api_port.description: Local viewer/API port. Restart and update browser URL after changes.

write_detection_log.description: Save detection metadata only, not video.

camera_stationary.description: Must remain true; no moving-camera compensation yet.

allow_size_based_speed.description: Allow rough m/s and arrival estimates from assumed object heights. False requires calibrated ground scale.

minimum_observation_s.description: Minimum track duration before reporting speed.

velocity_window_s.description: Recent history used for least-squares velocity smoothing.

maximum_track_gap_s.description: Drop identities after this detection gap.

maximum_velocity_gap_s.description: Reset velocity history after this gap.

association_distance_fraction.description: Maximum matching displacement as fraction of image diagonal.

image_motion_threshold_px_s.description: Image-speed threshold used to describe movement.

metric_motion_threshold_mps.description: Suppress zone forecasts below this noisy low-speed range.

front_zone.description: Example camera-relative area for point arrival estimates, not physical collision.
